methodDiagram.nativeDisposition: Source grid/rule geometry and source text centers retained; text uses native lesson fonts at readable size; narrow views scroll the diagram. Each independent glyph mask/alpha/RGB curve is preserved.

pages.nativeGlyphForegroundPolicy: Each source foreground letter remains a decorative native glyph over its own underlying native glyph. Exact source signed offset divided by source font height 400 twips becomes em, preserving 0 or 0.035em horizontally and -0.0025em vertically. Native font contours and advances replace source contours; no pixel-parity claim. Math foreground instances are unmerged source-depth layers.
